span.p: Untrusted: the browser and uploaded files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
project documents leave the server
only to approved models

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Input checks
.xlsx only, 25 MB cap
scorecard checked against a strict schema

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Workbook reader
parses the file as data
never runs macros or formulas

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Freeze
hash before and after
the file is only ever read

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
API keys
server environment only
never sent to the browser or logged

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Roster gate
approved models only
3 distinct families

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence gate
a claim must cite a real cell,
so text hidden in a file cannot
invent findings
